summary: Inspected all retained widths (1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px), their responsive JSON probes and screenshots. Account panels remain side by side at 1440/1280/1024, stack at 768/390/375, and all visible account controls remain available. Overflow is 0 through 390 px, but the retained 375 px probe reports 1 px horizontal overflow.
issues: AUD-ACCOUNT-RESPONSIVE-001 | priority: low | property: horizontal overflow at 375 px | expected: 0 px overflow at every retained width | actual: responsive-375.json reports overflow 1 while the account wrappers (x 20, width 335) and recorded text/image/link boxes remain within the viewport | fix: identify the 1 px scroll-width contributor at 375 px, including borders or pseudo-elements, and constrain it without changing the healthy account stacking behavior.
